data.title: Bitcoin Enters Death Cross as Anthropic IPO Fails to Lift Wall Street
data.description: Anthropic shares surged on their Nasdaq debut, but stocks slid and Bitcoin fell lower. Its daily chart shows deeply oversold momentum, a strong downtrend, and fragile support.
